description:
A neat little application that allows you to draw on your screen

iScribby is a screen-drawing application: use it anywhere — on your desktop, while browsing the internet, or even in a video game — to draw, highlight, and annotate directly on the screen during presentations, streams, and lessons.
- Added the ability to resize text.
- Fix - text tool issue involving having a letter unnecessarily capitalized when typing a capital letter using shift key and typing another one without it.
- Marquee tool is now available outside premium mode.
- Updated the selected color to now get saved.
- Optimization - made the app monitor settings for changes and save them once a set period, instead of saving everything on every single action.
- Premium mode can now be enabled using a license key.
- Updated activate freezeframe setting value to get saved.
- Fix - opacity slider displaying an incorrect value on app launch.
